mode_meaning: buffers freed and reallocated between EXAMPLES; isolates warm-state carryover
protocol: IDENTICAL in all modes: 2 invocations x (5 warmup + 20 timed) = 40 timed launches per example. Only the ISOLATION varies, which is the point -- this experiment varies one thing at a time rather than optimising two at once.

worker.protocol_note: IDENTICAL to 7.1: 5 warmup + 20 timed, 2 invocations, 40 timed launches per example. Only the number of PROCESS STARTS changed, from 2 per example to 1 for the batch. The trial count that buys each label is untouched.

device_time_per_example.note: derived from the committed cells' medians x launches per example; this is the quantity the throughput fix must NOT move

per_example_sampling.sampling_is_a_real_cost: per-example telemetry costs 6.4 ms per example and is reported SEPARATELY rather than folded into an unattributed residual. It is the price of the per-row observation this bead's constraint 2 requires, and hiding it inside 'overhead' would be the same mistake as not splitting it out at all.
per_example_sampling.note: every row carries its own queue_state and its own telemetry, taken at that row's time. A per-batch sample stamped onto many rows would satisfy the letter of the row carrying a field while observing nothing.
